Query: which type of engine is used in the aircraft with the smallest cargo capacity?
Rationale: The Candidate correctly models the query logic. It identifies the aircraft (e1) with the minimum cargo capacity by comparing its attribute to the result of a SCALAR_AGGREGATE (MIN) over the set of all aircraft (e3). It then correctly navigates the relationship (r1) from the aircraft to the engine (e2) and targets the 'type' attribute of that engine. This is semantically equivalent to the Ground Truth's ARGMIN logic.
